name: Men's Black Strap Watch, Bracelet, Pendant and Ring Set
description: Four pieces in one set: a black quartz watch on a black strap, a black Cuban chain bracelet, a black bullet pendant necklace on a cord and a black spinner ring. Choose the dial: red numerals, blue markers or Roman numerals. The gift box in the photos is not included.

source.notes: HELD pending the owner's decision on the dial print. Same supplier listing as black-steel-watch-gift-set (see its notes for the shop, price and photo details): 3 leather-strap styles, each with the bullet pendant on a cord. All three dials are printed GENEVA / Geneva (a generic fashion-watch marking that reads as a Swiss-origin claim); it cannot be cropped out and was not retouched, because that would change what the buyer receives. The word is kept out of the name, copy and tags. Photos: supplier watermark cropped out of the two 1000 px originals; the Roman-numeral original had none. unit_cost 20 is the owner's costing base (listing shows CNY 13.5); fx_rate unset, the screenshot shows no naira figure. Strap material (genuine leather or imitation) not stated, so 'black strap' only. The screenshot (style 9/9) names the red-numeral set 'Mig black silver + bullet set'; the other style names were not shown. Store return rate not shown: not checked. Case size, ring size, bracelet length, weight, battery type not stated; none claimed. ships_by_air left unset like the other watches in the store.
